verdict.rationale: Nitrokey publishes a public documentation site, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. Probes found no such resource: llms.txt and the markdown docs variant both returned HTTP 404. Nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented documentation of any kind.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
